purpose: Re-rank first-order blind-memory gaps after the DOWN-NEV demand-translation probe while preserving prior matrix decisions as immutable history.

campaign_state.interpretation: UP-HARDROCK and DOWN-NEV ordinary v6 probes each produced two new categories, two useful refinements and one duplicate. Novelty is measurably lower than the earlier all-new batches but remains materially high. Neither shard starts a seal streak.

newly_explicit_dimensions: battery production/sales/installed-capacity GWh as distinct dated states between vehicle activity and material consumption
chemistry-specific installed-GWh-to-lithium-material intensity as an explicit cross-shard bridge
refined_dimensions: finished-vehicle inventory as batteries/materials already consumed before retail or registration
large-pack commercial vehicles as a vehicle-count-to-GWh mix correction
completed_probe.duplicate_signal: production/wholesale/retail/registration/export metric mismatch materially repeated existing NEV metric and inventory leads

UP-HARDROCK.reason: Effective-supply translation now has customer acceptance, material-balance and ramp-guidance states. More immediate hard-rock recall would be local drilling.

DOWN-NEV.reason: Demand translation now separates vehicle metrics, battery production/installation timing, commercial-vehicle mix and chemistry-specific material intensity. Remaining gaps should be triggered by the replay rather than another immediate NEV pass.

remaining_negative_space: converter nameplate/commissioning versus stable battery-grade output through recovery, yield, purification and product qualification
feed availability and ownership across captive, tolling and merchant conversion
carbonate/hydroxide and technical/battery-grade substitution limits during 2018-2020 falling prices
concentrate arrival, WIP, finished chemical inventory, sales and customer acceptance as distinct dated states
converter ramp guidance and expectation revisions rather than only final nameplate or production outcomes
UP-CHEMICALS.reason: The two outer legs of the first-order replay are now better specified: mine/concentrate effective supply upstream and vehicle/battery/material demand downstream. The largest remaining middle-layer ambiguity is how nominal conversion capacity became saleable battery-grade lithium chemical supply at each historical date.

BAT-CELL.reason: The NEV probe exposed battery production-versus-installation timing, but BAT-CELL should only be re-opened if the conversion probe leaves a material inventory/qualification bridge between chemical supply and installed GWh.

MID-LFP_and_MID-TERNARY.reason: Chemistry-specific lithium intensity is now explicitly identified as a bridge, but both cathode shards already have strong compact coverage. Do not expand them until a concrete replay residual requires chemistry-level refinement.

probe_protocol.target: Translate announced/commissioned converter capacity into stable saleable battery-grade lithium chemical supply and its contemporaneous expectation revisions. Do not collect more plant announcements for their own sake.
inputs_forbidden: later outcomes used to rewrite historical conversion expectations
probe_protocol.after_probe: Re-rank again before any BAT-CELL, cathode or repeat-supply/demand probe. Do not auto-run a queue.
probe_protocol.seal_effect: Only an observed low-novelty batch can start a qualifying streak; all current shard streaks remain zero.
